scenes.headline: How a Vulkan port re-renders a frame, bit for bit
scenes.sub: The network behind DLSS 5 neural rendering, read from the code.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Juno! This is an open rebuild of NVIDIA's neural rendering network, in Vulkan.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Matching the network means matching every rounding: each value between kernels is an FP8 byte or a half, rounded in a fixed order.
scenes.say: Matching this network isn't about an error bound. It means matching every rounding, in order.

scenes.title: One frame in, one frame out

steps.say: The input is the frame the game already drew, plus three lanes of noise.
And the previous output, moved along the motion vectors.
A seventy-one block U-net re-renders it at the same size. It is not an upscaler.
Out comes a colour residual, and a weight that blends the history back in.

scenes.title: Down to a ViT and back

steps.say: Every block above the bottom attends inside eight by eight windows.

steps.note: halve the image, double the channels
steps.say: Each level halves the image and doubles the channels.
At the bottom, a ViT attends over every token at once.
Then a decoder climbs back up, with a skip from each level.

scenes.title: Why the order of roundings matters
scenes.say: Round to a half first, then to eight bits.

parts.note: round to half first, nearest even
parts.say: The half can land exactly on the boundary between two codes.

parts.note: then the tie goes to the even code
parts.say: Then the tie goes to the even code.

parts.note: 1 in 256 floats differ if you skip it
parts.say: Skip the half step, and one float in two hundred fifty-six changes.

items.say: Thirteen G L S L shaders are the readable specification.
P T X kernels, generated by Python, are what runs.
They wait on counters, not barriers, with a watchdog.
Both match captures byte for byte, at seventy-five boundaries.

The new skin detail comes from the noise, not a sharper render.

scenes.title: Network time, RTX 4070 SUPER
scenes.note: the network alone, minimum over 40 frames
scenes.say: At ten eighty p, the network alone takes seven point seven seven milliseconds.

scenes.text: A quantized network is a sequence of roundings. Reproduce the order, and you reproduce the network.
scenes.say: A quantized network is a sequence of roundings. Reproduce the order, and you reproduce the network.
